# nagios_contactgroup (Resource)

Manages a Nagios XI contactgroup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nagios_contactgroup" "example" {
  contactgroup_name = "on-call"
  alias              = "On-Call Team"
  members            = [nagios_contact.example.contact_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) A longer description of the contact group
- `contactgroup_name` (String) The name of the contact group

### Optional

- `contactgroup_members` (Set of String) A list of other contactgroups whose members should be included in this group
- `members` (Set of String) A list of the short names of contacts that are members of this group

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Contact groups can be imported by their contactgroup_name.
terraform import nagios_contactgroup.example on-call
```
